message:
Fix startup recovery and persistence failures (#211)

Scene exceptions or stalled scene loaders could leave startup without a retry screen because the failure boundary ended before Boot/Menu finished. Keep it open through the first usable Menu frame and dispose scoped listeners on success, error and abort. Real Phaser browser fixtures cover thrown errors, rejected promises, stalls, late completion and healthy startup.

A failed profile migration disk write could leave an unpersisted claim visible in memory. Stage the candidate and publish it only after the atomic local write; fault tests verify signed reads remain unchanged, retry claims once, and durable restore retains the result. Telegram registry mirror-write failures now lower health until a successful write; rejected registration remains uncommitted.

CI additionally builds the standalone telegram-bot Docker target and imports it with networking disabled, fake credentials and a deadline, preventing missing module dependencies from escaping the existing text guard.

Validation: six real-browser startup cases, existing review-browser scenarios, TypeScript, startup contracts, Telegram bot contract and the full server suite (75 core checks plus security/durable/hosting suites) passed locally. New behavior regressions failed before their fixes. Independent Luna review found no P1/P2. Production-config build of exact head545b0c2 passed without QA hooks. Local Docker Desktop could not start; the actual image build and offline import both passed hosted production-contract job in CI38639132437. The separate Render Density QA38639132496 also passed; the full browser job and publication remain pending. A fresh private backup revision142 (74 scores) passed hash round-trip and isolated restore. Physical MAX/Telegram, S20+, iOS, FPS and newcomer acceptance remain open.
